598144: • Linked, not covered: the ItsDrDan study games and interactive labs, the PhET simulations, YouTube's player, and the ADAPT homework platform are separate products with their own accessibility; they are optional or have equivalents in the text, as noted below.

• Embedded, tested separately: the ItsDrDan study games and interactive labs appear in Explore It boxes and on the Practice Games pages. They are optional practice, and each section teaches the same skills in accessible text. The conformance table below rates the book's own pages and Try It boxes, not the games. On November 20, 2026, the opening screen of all 83 embedded game and lab frames passed an automated WCAG 2.1 A/AA scan (axe-core) at phone width, and keyboard focus moved into and out of each frame. Later game steps were not scanned, the games have not had a screen-reader listening test, and some games use animation or single-key shortcuts. In Final Boss Topic Training, the Enter key runs Check Answer even when another button has focus; the Space key activates the focused button.
  • Linked, not covered: the PhET simulations, YouTube's player, and the ADAPT homework platform are separate products with their own accessibility; they are optional or have equivalents in the text, as noted below.
598094: The games linked from the Practice Games pages are optional practice and have no required timed mode.

The games in the Explore It boxes and on the Practice Games pages are optional practice and have no required timed mode. Each section teaches the same skills in the text. Their opening screens passed the same automated scan on November 20, 2026; details are in the Accessibility Conformance Report.
